Strategy
The fund is a balanced fund mainly investing in fixed-income and equity funds managed by fund companies belonging to the Nordea Group. The fund can also make direct equity and fixed-income investments and invest in external funds and Exchange Traded Funds. The proportion of direct investments of the fund’s assets can be 45% at the most. The proportion of fixed-income and equity investments of the fund's assets may vary between 25% and 75% based on the market view of the portfolio manager.
